--dc-ip.help: IP Address of the domain controller. If omitted it will use the domain part (FQDN) specified in the target parameter

--domain.help: Windows domain name to authenticate to the machine.

--export-json.help: Export results to specified JSON file.

--export-sqlite.help: Export results to specified SQLITE3 database file.

--export-xlsx.help: Export results to specified XLSX file.

--listener.help: IP address or hostname of the listener machine

--listener-ip.help: IP address or hostname of the listener machine

--only-known-exploit-paths.help: Only test known exploit paths for each functions

--password.help: Password to authenticate to the machine. (if omitted, it will be asked unless -no-pass is specified)

--target.help: IP address or hostname of the target machine

--target-ip.help: IP address or hostname of the target machine

--targets-file.help: File containing a list of IP address or hostname of the target machines

--username.help: Username to authenticate to the machine.

--webdav-host.help: WebDAV IP of the server to authenticate to.

--webdav-port.help: WebDAV port of the server to authenticate to.

coerce.help: Trigger authentications through all known methods with known working paths

fuzz.help: Tests every method with a list of exploit paths, and report when an authentication is received.
